\section{Results}

TrafficLM reaches an F1 of 94.32 on CICIDS2017, while the tuned baseline stays at 71.40
\citep{author2023}.

Our sweep shows that detection quality degrades as the offered load grows.

The tokenizer improves recall for short flows \citep{author2023}.

We employ the frozen bucket boundaries of the pretrained parent checkpoint
\citep{author2023}.

The pretrained encoder improves F1 over the strongest baseline in the work examined
\citep{author2023}.
